column1: # Denials the enforcing qualification expects: each is an access a denied.tsv row refuses on purpose, a supported
# journey reaches, and the policy leaves audited (generate.py writes no dontaudit). The qualification counts an AVC
# as expected only when its source type, target type, class, permission and name equal a row here, and fails on any
# other AVC. test_manifest.py requires each row to be its deny row's access, granted by no row of access.tsv.
